sections.value: Clarification of #263 after-cost receipt 00b2dd38 (2026-11-19T07:54:04.407137Z–07:54:24.645311Z): Falcon confirms no /restart overlapped the measurement. The window overlapped startup/folder-trust waiting of throwaway proxied Copilot seat pij-only-boar, pane %377. Its spawn.launched was 07:53:56Z, before the measurement began; it remained at the trust prompt during the window and spawn.failed for wait timeout occurred at 07:54:56Z. Therefore this is not an idle-only baseline and not a /restart-path measurement. It includes an in-progress Copilot spawn startup, not a launch initiation inside the interval. Source: direct message from pij-cultural-falcon. The measured values and all-zero daemon launch counter deltas are unchanged. Falcon will supply individual /restart timestamps in its separate live-proof receipt to pij-steady-otter.
